name: Kedarnath Temple
description: One of the twelve Jyotirlingas at 3583 m, reached by a 16 km trek or helicopter from Sonprayag. Part of the Char Dham circuit.

name: Badrinath Temple
description: Sacred Vishnu shrine between Nar and Narayan peaks on the banks of Alaknanda. Tapt Kund hot spring lies below the temple.

name: Har Ki Pauri
description: Most revered ghat of Haridwar. The evening Ganga Aarti with floating diyas is the highlight of any visit.

name: Mansa Devi Temple
description: Hilltop Shakti temple reached by ropeway with a panoramic view of Haridwar city and the Ganga.

name: Triveni Ghat
description: Largest ghat of Rishikesh where the Maha Aarti is performed every evening at sunset.

name: Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula
description: Iconic suspension bridges across the Ganga surrounded by ashrams, temples and riverside cafes.

name: Ganga River Rafting
description: 16 to 26 km white water rafting stretches from Shivpuri and Marine Drive with Grade II and III rapids.

name: Bungee Jumping Mohanchatti
description: 83 m fixed platform bungee jump, one of the highest in India, run by trained jump masters.

name: Neer Garh Waterfall
description: A short forest trek from Laxman Jhula road leads to these twin waterfalls with natural pools.

name: Beatles Ashram
description: Abandoned Maharishi Mahesh Yogi ashram where the Beatles stayed in 1968, now an art and meditation space inside Rajaji reserve.

name: Robber's Cave
description: A 600 m river cave where a cold stream flows between narrow gorge walls. Locally called Gucchupani.

name: Sahastradhara
description: Thousand fold spring with sulphur water terraces and a ropeway to the hilltop viewpoint.

name: Forest Research Institute
description: Greco Roman heritage campus of 1906 with six forestry museums, a favourite film shooting location.

name: Mindrolling Monastery
description: One of the largest Buddhist centres in India with the 60 m Great Stupa and peaceful gardens.

name: Mall Road Mussoorie
description: The heart of the Queen of Hills lined with cafes, view points and colonial era buildings.

name: Kempty Falls
description: 40 ft waterfall 15 km from Mussoorie with bathing pools and a ropeway across the valley.

name: Gun Hill Ropeway
description: Second highest point of Mussoorie with cable car rides and Himalayan panorama on clear days.

name: George Everest Peak
description: House and viewpoint of Sir George Everest with 360 degree views of Doon valley and Aglar river valley.

name: Dhanaulti Eco Park
description: Quiet deodar forest ridge at 2286 m with eco park zip lines and Surkanda Devi temple nearby.

name: Tehri Lake Water Sports
description: 42 sq km reservoir of Tehri dam offering jet ski, banana boat rides and floating huts.

name: Naini Lake Boating
description: Emerald mountain lake at the centre of Nainital, best enjoyed on a wooden row boat at sunrise.

name: Naina Devi Temple
description: Shakti Peeth on the northern shore of Naini lake, rebuilt after the 1880 landslide.

name: Snow View Point Ropeway
description: Aerial ropeway to 2270 m viewpoint showing Nanda Devi and Trishul on clear mornings.

name: Tiffin Top Trek
description: 4 km forest walk to Dorothy Seat with views over the lake town and the Himalaya.

name: Eco Cave Gardens
description: Network of six natural caves shaped like animals, popular with families and children.

name: Bhimtal Lake
description: Larger and calmer than Naini lake with an island aquarium and nearby paragliding at Naukuchiatal.

name: Naukuchiatal Paragliding
description: Tandem paragliding over the nine cornered lake, one of the best flying sites in Kumaon.

name: Mukteshwar Dhar
description: Apple orchard village at 2286 m with Chauli ki Jali cliff, rappelling and a 350 year old Shiva temple.

name: Jim Corbett Safari Bijrani
description: Jeep safari in the Bijrani and Garjiya zones of India's oldest national park, famous for Bengal tigers.

name: Corbett Dhikala Zone
description: Core grassland zone of Corbett with forest rest houses inside the reserve. Day visits by canter bus.

name: Garjiya Devi Temple
description: Temple perched on a large rock in the Kosi river near the Corbett buffer forest.

name: Kausani Sunrise Point
description: Gandhi called it the Switzerland of India. 300 km wide Himalayan panorama and tea gardens.

name: Ranikhet Golf Course
description: One of the highest golf courses in Asia surrounded by pine forest in the quiet cantonment town.

name: Kasar Devi Temple Ridge
description: 2nd century temple ridge known for its geomagnetic field, visited by Swami Vivekananda and Bob Dylan era travellers.

name: Jageshwar Dham
description: Cluster of 124 ancient stone temples from the 7th to 14th century set in a deodar grove.

name: Chopta Tungnath Trek
description: 3.5 km trek from Chopta meadows to Tungnath, the highest Shiva temple, and 1.5 km further to Chandrashila summit.

name: Deoria Tal
description: Emerald lake at 2438 m reflecting Chaukhamba peaks, reached by a 2.5 km trek from Sari village.

name: Auli Ropeway and Slopes
description: Premier ski resort of India at 2800 m with one of Asia's longest ropeways from Joshimath and views of Nanda Devi.

name: Valley of Flowers Trek
description: UNESCO World Heritage alpine valley that blooms with over 500 flower species between July and September.

name: Hemkund Sahib
description: Highest gurudwara in the world at 4329 m beside a glacial lake, reached by a steep 6 km trek from Ghangaria.

name: Gangotri Temple
description: Origin shrine of the Ganga at 3100 m. Gaumukh glacier trek starts from here.

name: Yamunotri Temple
description: Source shrine of the Yamuna reached by a 6 km trek from Janki Chatti, with Surya Kund hot spring.

name: Harsil Valley
description: Untouched apple growing valley on the Bhagirathi at 2620 m, base for Sattal and Gartang Gali walks.

name: Rishikesh Camping Shivpuri
description: Riverside camps at Shivpuri with rafting combos, bonfire and beach volleyball.

name: Munsiyari Khaliya Top
description: Meadow trek above Munsiyari with close range views of the five Panchachuli peaks.

name: Patal Bhuvaneshwar Cave
description: 90 m deep limestone cave temple complex describing Hindu cosmology in rock formations.

name: Chaukori Tea Gardens
description: Tiny ridge top hamlet with tea gardens facing a wall of snow peaks from Nanda Devi to Panchachuli.

name: Rajaji National Park Safari
description: Jeep safari in the Chilla zone known for wild elephants, leopards and 300 plus bird species.

name: Lakhamandal Temple
description: Ancient Shiva temple complex linked to the Mahabharata lacquer house legend, on the Yamuna valley route.

name: Chakrata Tiger Falls
description: 98 m waterfall inside deodar forest, one of the highest direct falls in Uttarakhand.
